recipes.title: Foolproof Cacio e Pepe

items.i: Pecorino Romano, freshly grated (about 1½ cups), plus extra to serve
black peppercorns, coarsely cracked (60–70 grinds), plus extra to serve

steps: Bring a smaller-than-usual pot of water to a boil (less water means more starch). Season lightly with salt.
Cook the spaghetti for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Meanwhile, toast the cracked pepper in a dry pan over medium heat for about 2 minutes until fragrant, without burning.
Turn the pepper pan to low, add 2–2½ ladles of starchy pasta water, then simmer over medium-high for about 2 minutes, scraping in any pepper from the sides.
Add the spaghetti with a little more pasta water and turn the heat OFF.
Add all the Pecorino and toss quickly so the residual heat melts it into a creamy sauce. Freshly grated cheese is key; pre-grated has anti-caking agents that make it clump.
Loosen with more pasta water to the consistency you like, using a little low heat only if needed to bring it together.
Serve in bowls with extra Pecorino and cracked pepper.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; serves 2 generously (or 3 smaller portions). Macros are estimates.
